subject: general
question: The ratio of the present ages of Sandhya and Vindhya is 1 : 3 and 3 years ago the ratio was 1 : 4. What will be the ratio of their ages after 3 years?
solution:
The ratio of the present ages of Sandhya and Vindhya = 1 : 3

Let;

Age of Sandhya = P

Age of Vindhya = 3P

3 years ago:

Age of Sandhya 3 years ago = (P - 3) years

Age of Vindhya 3 years ago = (3P - 3) years

**According to the question:**

The ratio of the ages of Sandhya and Vindhya 3 years ago = 1 : 4</p
